clue.text: Fruit chopped near a city

indicators.note: something chopped has had a piece cut off, here its end

blocks.note: a lime is a citrus fruit
taken as written

explanation.surface: Sliced fruit lies close to a town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Near' simply sets the A beside the shortened fruit. Lima is also a bean, a nice touch of misdirection.
explanation.definitionFit: Lima is the capital and largest metropolis of Peru, on the Pacific coast.

clue.text: Dossier contains lady with a grand bird of prey

indicators.note: to contain is to hold inside, so one piece sits within another

blocks.note: a dossier is a file of papers
she refers to a woman
taken as written
G is slang for a grand, a thousand

explanation.surface: A file mentions a woman worth a thousand and a hunting bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lady with a grand' reads as a rich woman; it is three separate pieces packed into the file.
explanation.definitionFit: Fish eagles are large raptors that snatch fish from water, such as the African fish eagle.

clue.text: Queen put on a lot of perfume approaching unknown landscape

indicators.note: a lot of something is most but not all, so the word loses its final letter
in an across clue putting one piece on another adds it to the end

blocks.note: scent is perfume
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the late Queen's cipher
Y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: The monarch dabs on heavy fragrance before a mysterious view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put on' looks like applying perfume but places ER after the shortened scent. Mathematicians call unknowns x, y and z.
explanation.definitionFit: Scenery is the natural features of a district viewed as a picture, so the same as a vista or landscape.
